source_scope: Archived calculated Jie and source-conditioned Gregorian software policy; shared astronomical frame, no independent observation or originaltext accuracy credit. UTC raw civil fixture isolates calendar carrying; not physical birth records.
hypothesis: Reverse three-days-one-year civil calendar addition can jump backward at a nominal30day carry because the birth day is clipped in the resulting Gregorian month. A short pre-carry before_dayun state can be missed by original minute grid and natal event probes.
selection: All archived Jie pairs spanning1900..2100; for every preceding Jie test k=1..132 inclusive at root+k*6elapsedhours, provided birth is1900..2100 and before the next Jie. Select every negative initial-boundary jump between carry-1microsecond and carry+1microsecond. Do not select using application output or discard awkward cases.
reference_arithmetic: Integer elapsed microseconds multiplied120; divmod360nominaldays then30nominaldays; apply years/months together by Gregorian calendar.monthrange clipping, then days and remaining microseconds. Standard datetime/calendar only, no fatebridge/dateutil/ZoneInfo.
fixtures: Whole-second nominal center=floor(carry)-30seconds, +/-1elapsedminute; analysis_at=manual_initial_boundary(carry-1microsecond)-40minutes. Keep all selected rows even if grid does not miss state; independent probes carry-10seconds, carry-1microsecond, carry, carry+1microsecond.
reference_precision_scope: Exact integer software arithmetic on archived computed roots; microsecond representation is not astronomical or birth-record accuracy. Actual floating conversion differences diagnosed separately with fixed0.1second start_at tolerance; state labels have multi-second margins except exactcarry which remains diagnostic.
